businessModel: Free; funded by Google Search/advertising ecosystem; Gemini features partly gated behind Google AI Pro/Ultra subscriptions
paidNote: Browser is free; Gemini auto browse requires Google AI Pro/Ultra (US)
updateCadence: Every 2 weeks since Chrome 153 (Sept 8, 2026; previously 4 weeks); weekly security updates; Extended Stable every 8 weeks
summary: The world's most used browser: fastest-moving engine, best site compatibility and a huge extension store, but weak default privacy, no MV2 ad blockers any more, and increasingly woven into Gemini.
bestFor: People who want maximum site compatibility and polish
Developers testing against the reference engine
Users who want Gemini built into the browser
notFor: People who want strong tracker/ad blocking out of the box
Users who want full uBlock Origin (MV2 is gone)
Anyone who wants to minimise Google data collection

pros.title: Best compatibility
pros.detail: Sites are built and tested against Chrome first, so almost everything just works.

pros.title: Fast engine
pros.detail: V8 and Blink lead or tie the field on JavaScript and graphics workloads.

pros.title: Polished sync
pros.detail: Bookmarks, passwords, passkeys, tabs and settings follow your Google account across every OS.

pros.title: Native vertical tabs
pros.detail: Vertical tab layout rolled out to stable from Chrome 147 (April 2026), plus saved tab groups and split view.

pros.title: Gemini built in
pros.detail: Gemini side panel, AI Mode in the address bar, on-device Gemini Nano scam detection and auto browse for subscribers.

pros.title: Security cadence
pros.detail: Weekly security updates and a two-week major cycle since Chrome 153; HTTPS-by-default from Chrome 154.

cons.title: Weak default privacy
cons.detail: Third-party cookies are still allowed and there is no content blocker or strong anti-fingerprinting.

cons.title: MV2 fully gone
cons.detail: Manifest V2 was disabled from Chrome 138-139 and all MV2 extensions were purged from the Web Store on 2026-08-31; only uBlock Origin Lite-style MV3 blockers remain.

cons.title: Heavy on RAM
cons.detail: Memory use is high compared with Safari and Firefox despite Memory Saver.

cons.title: Google-centric AI and data
cons.detail: Gemini features push you toward a signed-in Google account and parts need a paid AI plan.

signatureFeatures: Gemini in Chrome and auto browse
Google account sync and Password Manager with passkeys
Native vertical tabs and tab groups
Enhanced Safe Browsing with on-device Gemini Nano

faq.q: Can I still use uBlock Origin in Chrome?
faq.a: No. Manifest V2 support was removed (disabled in Chrome 138-139, Web Store MV2 purge on 2026-08-31, MV2 code deleted in Chrome 151). Use uBlock Origin Lite (MV3) or switch to Firefox for the full version.

faq.q: Does Chrome for Android support extensions?
faq.a: No. Standard Chrome for Android and iOS have no extension support; extension-capable desktop-class Chromium builds are experimental and aimed at Android-based PCs.

faq.q: How often does Chrome update now?
faq.a: Every two weeks since Chrome 153 (September 8, 2026), with security fixes shipped weekly.
